verdict.rationale: Browserbase offers full programmatic browser control with "auto-waits" (docs-4) and a fetch capability that converts any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown (docs-3). That means a developer can likely wait on elements through session-based browser control. However, no evidence shows the fetch/render API itself accepting a wait-for-selector parameter before returning the page. missing for 10: an explicit wait-for-selector option on the page-fetch API, documentation of selector-wait semantics (timeouts, visibility), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
